# iNEST_Topology

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-09-22

## Definition
The topological structure and connectivity organization of in-network neuromorphic systems, determining how spiking nodes and links interact. It is the core substrate for mapping neuromorphic computation onto network topology and analyzing emergent dynamics in iNEST.
